verdict_basis: The sealed files and authored 23-test validation replay exactly, but independent adversarial checks expose two paths that grant V2 despite evidence that should fail closed.

findings.title: A weaker profile can reuse the sealed profile ID and version and grant V2

evidence.behavior: _profile_current accepts any repository-local JSON file whose caller-supplied digest matches and whose profile_id/profile_version equal the invocation fields. It does not bind the invocation to the sealed profile path or digest, nor validate the loaded profile shape.
evidence.input_change: A temporary exact profile retained profile_id evf.core.verification-tiers.v0-v2 and profile_version 1, but changed V2 to one route, no independence, and no controls. One provider then received V2.

findings.implication: Exact-byte binding to an attacker-selected profile does not preserve the tier contract's identity. The candidate can silently weaken V2 while presenting the same profile identity.
findings.required_resolution: Bind evaluation to an authorized profile path and digest, or make profile identity content-addressed and validate the complete loaded profile against a closed schema before applying requirements.

findings.title: A surviving declared negative control is ignored when its class is also covered by a passing control

evidence.behavior: Control enforcement reduces controls to the set of classes having at least one expected_non_success=true and detected=true record. It does not fail when another declared expected-non-success control in the same class has detected=false.
evidence.input_change: A sixth subject-class control with expected_non_success=true and detected=false was added beside the passing subject-class control.

findings.implication: V2 can be granted while a declared negative control survives, contradicting the candidate's fail-closed control claim.
findings.required_resolution: Require every declared expected-non-success control to be detected and still require complete class coverage; reject duplicate or contradictory control records when their semantics are not explicitly defined.

findings.title: No voting, no silent downgrade, and contract/property separation replay correctly

evidence.three_route_majority: Two no-counterexample results plus one counterexample produced conflicting_evidence and no verified tier.
evidence.lower_tier: A V2 request without controls preserved requested_tier V2, left verified_tier null, and reported available_lower_tier V1.
evidence.counterexample: Two agreeing counterexample providers plus complete controls produced contract_state satisfied, property_outcome counterexample, and verified_tier V2.

findings.title: Historical compatibility is additive and presently not evaluable

evidence.historical_profile_hashes: L0, L1, and L2 profile hashes and sizes exactly match compatibility/tde.v1-candidate.json.
evidence.evaluator_result: not_evaluable with tier_granted false for every mapping and retroactive_verification false

exact_commands: node - <<'NODE' ... recompute SHA-256 and size for every AUTHOR-MANIFEST.json entry ... NODE
node - <<'NODE' ... recompute compatibility-record SHA-256 and size for L0/L1/L2 profiles and runtime binding ... NODE

for p in ../.formal-tools/souffle/2.5/usr/bin/souffle ../.formal-tools/jre/current/bin/java ../.formal-tools/alloy/org.alloytools.alloy.dist-6.2.0.jar; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then sha256sum "$p"; else echo "MISSING $p"; fi; done
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY' ... six independent adversarial cases recorded in REPLAY.log ... PY
claim_ceiling: Independent local construction replay and current exact-file compatibility assessment only; no product approval, governance admission, runtime admission, publication, release, deployment, or operational authority.
